hints.title: Algebraic Sum Formulation
hints.text: Three consecutive integers can be written as x - 1, x, and x + 1, whose sum is exactly 3x.

hints.title: Divisibility by Three
hints.text: A solution exists if and only if num is divisible by 3.

hints.title: Calculate Sequence
hints.text: If divisible, the middle integer is num // 3, and the consecutive triplet is [x - 1, x, x + 1].

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching linearly for triplets takes unbounded time for large 64-bit numbers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct algebraic division solves the problem in constant time.

solutions.approach: Java long division and triplet return.
